question: _______________ was crowned Miss Universe India 2025.
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Manika Vishwakarma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Manika Vishwakarma crowned Miss Universe India 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Manika Vishwakarma** from **Ganganagar, Rajasthan** crowned **Miss Universe India 2025** in Jaipur.

 
 
• 
 
Manika will represent **India** at the **74th Miss Universe** competition in **Thailand** later this year.

 
 
• 
 
India has a proud history at **Miss Universe**, with previous winners including:

 
 
• 
 
**Sushmita Sen (1994)** – first Indian to win Miss Universe.

 
 
• 
 
**Lara Dutta (2000)** – second Indian Miss Universe.

 
 
• 
 
**Harnaaz Sandhu (2021)** – third Miss Universe crown for India after two decades.
